Reference input for the robust summarisation check (69 percent)

Source: R/A_dataset_docu.R
data_checksummarizerobust69.Rd

log2 peptide areas of one protein, used by the tests of the robust (medpolish/rlm) protein summarisation. See `inst/script/README.md`.

Usage

data_checksummarizerobust69

Format

A data frame with 20 rows and the columns `log2Area`, `peptide_Id`, `sampleName`.

See also

Other data: PACKAGE_DATA, data_checksummarizationrobust87, data_ionstar, prolfqua_data(), x5463yzwer453bbb
